title: Pilot tips
cameraHelp: Cycle track, orbit, top-down and onboard views. Scroll to zoom in top-down.
rebindHelp: To change the pad or control layout, return to the main menu.
dismiss: Hide tips; do not auto-open next time
waiting: Waiting for a link; tips appear once vehicle state arrives.
modeUsb: USB controller owns the pilot axes

hints.replay: Replaying a recording. Use {camera} for other views; flight practice is for live dives.
hints.usbLost: USB controller is offline. Reconnect it, or return to the main menu to change input.
hints.paused: Dive paused. Wait for the host to resume before flying.
hints.latched: Controls auto-locked after a drop. Wait for sync, then press {lock} to unlock.
hints.locked: Clear the way ahead, then press {lock} to unlock; lock again when you want to stop.
hints.remote: An auto route or the SDK has control. Stop the cruise before practising manual flight.
hints.move: Use {drive} to move a short way forward and back, then centre. Current still drifts the vehicle.
hints.depth: Press {depth} for depth hold and centre heave. Depth stays put; horizontal drift can continue.
hints.light: Press {light} for lights, then {camera} for the onboard view ahead.
hints.snagged: The tether touched an obstacle; stop thrusting, watch the path, then back out.
hints.current: Current is strong. Use small steady corrections instead of large stick swings.
hints.done: {scenario}: basics done. You can hide the tips and follow the mission.
